summary: The source83 dispositions are retained. This triage separates six own reader fixes prepared in R3, candidate proof qualification, one explicitly remaining own projection-proof clause, and installed/native/human dependencies. Absence of global observation is not treated as an implementation defect.

ownCodeDeltaGroups.change: The final C08 case/result/request observation is followed by synchronous equality with the originally retained Request. Existing digest, source, ledger and authority checks remain.
ownCodeDeltaGroups.proof: calculation-history.test.ts reuses the actual Planner calculation and accepted C17 ledger; four finish/replacement cases target the final namespace authorization and renew valid reading/replay.

ownCodeDeltaGroups.change: Retained receipt and status egress require the same Request after final C08 observation. Durable attempt reservation, receipt-first reconciliation, canonical receipt proof and domain dispatch are unchanged.
ownCodeDeltaGroups.proof: application-indeterminate.test.ts adds four real UI finish/replacement cases after final receipt/status authorization, using the domain-authored receipt actually committed by Planner and recovered after provider reopen. Fresh authorized retry still returns that exact receipt with unchanged dispatch/review/confirmation counts.

ownCodeDeltaGroups.change: readCurrent/list retain Request after final C08 observation; registration/retry retain it after the final draft-authorization callback.
ownCodeDeltaGroups.proof: hot-topic-draft-domain.test.ts reuses real Dashboard C08 registration. Six finish/expiry cases cover read/list/retry; exact stored fields remain, fresh admission succeeds and source-race oracle is preserved.

ownCodeDeltaGroups.change: replayPortfolio retains Request after case read/authorization before its early not-found response. It does not create a reservation, receipt, portfolio result or domain effect.
ownCodeDeltaGroups.proof: portfolio-replay-lease-egress.test.ts has two real UI/C08 finish/expiry cases; both preserve complete durable state and a fresh admission returns not-found with zero domain or producer calls.

ownProofRemaining.action: Observe a populated authorized case projection section by section, binding origin/period/version for alternatives, assumptions, questions, choices, prepared changes, receipts and ledger. Do not use an empty-case proof or fabricated financial outcome as this enumeration.
ownProofRemaining.limit: Service projection enumeration can close only the own subclause; installed presentation still requires the consumer.

ownProofRemaining.action: Root publishes R3, then uses the eight exact selectors in r3-publication-manifest.json. No test, timeout change or remote dispatch was performed by this child.

externalGroups.remaining: Installed human choice to domain-generated Procurement proposals, formal approval where required, partial application and recovery in the same journey. Existing Planner execution and seeded cross-domain command proof remain scoped; WP13 G-RETRY is an additional concrete domain-dispatch subproof, not installed end-user acceptance.

Same canonical calculation/C10 result consumed by every named installed consumer: case UI, criticism and nonempty canonical portfolio. BI/source evidence already exists; source status must be reconciled with new Finance WP05/WP13 evidence without claiming all consumers.
Installed origin/period/version and complete/conditioned labels, supported N-A or pending reason per category, and proposal/destination presentation.
Installed provider composition and alternative editing with the same base and authority.
Observed user/team journey, comprehension of financial caveat, resolution and continuation without manual reconstruction. Automated service/renderer assertions cannot establish this human outcome.

Installed resident/native/MCP production and consumption, session/provider/capture/resources/skills authority and transport negatives. Source wiring and omni not-applicable are not positive resident-runtime proof.
approval-pending from the canonical domain producer. Unsupported submit_pr or a manufactured receipt is not that state.
